ranking.metric: Geometric-mean speedup versus the baseline over every case where the baseline has valid, correct runs. Designs missing any of those cases, or wrong on any, are not ranked. Equal values share a rank. No other metrics are combined into the score.

historical_runs.failure_reason: simulator error: In script <scratch>/case.tst, Line 4, too many arguments

dataset.unit: one row per (design, case); repeats collapsed

evaluation.protocol: Per design: GroupKFold (up to 5 folds) grouped by program SHA-256 (leave-programs-out). No input profile of a held-out program is seen in training. Metrics are over out-of-fold predictions.

definitions.backward_jump_count: Static jumps whose preceding @target is at or before the jump.
definitions.dyn_conditional_taken: Executed conditional jumps that were taken.
definitions.dyn_foldable_jumps: Executed canonical 0;JMP immediately preceded by an A-instruction.
definitions.dyn_instructions: Instructions retired by the ISA reference emulator before the halt address.
definitions.dyn_memory_reads: Executed instructions with an M operand.
definitions.instruction_count: Words in the program ROM image.
definitions.memory_reference_count: Static C-instructions that read or write M.
definitions.static_jump_count: Static C-instructions with any jump bits.

limitations: The dynamic features come from the ISA reference emulator, which executes the program. They are cheaper than HDL simulation but they are not a static prediction.
calibrated_isa needs measured runs of the design it predicts; the leave-one-design-out result shows it does not transfer to a design with a different CPI.
Several designs have identical timing (listed above); their per-design results are not independent evidence.
Programs come from 10 HackTwin/nand2tetris workloads and the GitHub workload set; predictions for very different programs (e.g. keyboard-driven or non-halting code) are outside the data.
The uncertainty band is the 90th-percentile absolute out-of-fold error for that design and model; it is an empirical spread, not a guaranteed interval.

predictors.calibrated_isa: Per-design least-squares fit: cycles = a x instructions + b x foldable jumps. Needs measured runs of that design.
predictors.extratrees_all: ExtraTrees regressor on log(cycles) using static and reference-emulator features.
predictors.extratrees_static: ExtraTrees regressor on log(cycles) using only static program features and inputs.
predictors.isa_cpi1: Instructions retired by the ISA reference emulator, assuming one cycle per instruction. Nothing is fitted.
predictors.median_baseline: Median cycles of the training programs for this design. The minimum any model must beat.
predictors.ridge_static: Ridge regression on cycles using only static program features and inputs (predictions clamped at 0).

predictor.target: cycles_to_halt measured by the nand2tetris Hardware Simulator through the TwinComputer harness

definitions.cycles_to_halt: Simulated clock cycles from the first cycle until the PC first reaches the program's halt address (its terminal loop, or the end of the program).
definitions.speedup: Baseline cycles / candidate cycles on the same case. Greater than 1 means the candidate needed fewer cycles.
definitions.cycle_reduction_pct: (Baseline cycles - candidate cycles) / baseline cycles x 100.
definitions.geomean_speedup: Geometric mean of per-case speedups over comparable cases; each case counts equally regardless of its length.
definitions.cpi: Cycles per instruction: cycles_to_halt / instructions retired by the ISA reference emulator on the same inputs.
definitions.host_elapsed_s: Wall-clock seconds of the simulator process on the host, including Java start-up. Not hardware time.
